segments.title: Chương 23: 0023【Phụ nữ chỉ cản trở tốc độ khởi nghiệp của tôi】
segments.content:
A Santana 2000 was parked in the open space in front of the building.

Yang Feifei, the campus belle of the Tourism Vocational High School, was sitting in the passenger seat, listening to music and playing Snake on her phone.

Hearing footsteps, Yang Feifei looked up and pouted, complaining coquettishly, "Honey, you're finally down. You promised to pick up my friends today, we're already running late. And they want to have Western food for lunch."

Tao Chenggang got into the driver's seat. "Call your friends and tell them we'll hang out another day. Be good, I have business to attend to today."

"No, no, you can't go back on your word."

Yang Feifei tugged at Tao Chenggang's hand, acting spoiled. It wasn't easy for her to land a young and rich boyfriend; of course she wanted to show him off to her friends.

Chen Guiliang opened the car door and slid into the back seat, silently watching the show.

Right now, Tao Chenggang's mind was completely focused on building his career. How could he have time to waste on a young girl?

The more his girlfriend acted cute, the more annoyed he felt. He couldn't help but raise his voice and snap, "Behave!"

Yang Feifei was startled and didn't dare to act up anymore. She just pouted and sulked.

"Gang Ge, wait a sec, wait a sec!"

Yang Yuhui ran over, panting.

Tao Chenggang asked, "What are you doing here? Someone needs to watch the studio."

Yang Yuhui squeezed into the car, sitting in the back with Chen Guiliang. "I've made all the arrangements. There won't be any problems at the studio."

Tao Chenggang couldn't be bothered to argue with him. He started the car and asked Chen Guiliang, "Which bank did you open your account with?"

Chen Guiliang said, "China Construction Bank."

In less than ten minutes, the Santana pulled up in front of a China Construction Bank branch.

Yang Feifei had been sulking and planning not to get out of the car, but seeing that Tao Chenggang was completely ignoring her, she quickly followed him into the bank lobby.

From start to finish, she had only glanced at Chen Guiliang once.

Hmph, his clothes are old and shabby. He's obviously a poor guy, and not even handsome.

Yang Yuhui didn't press for information anymore, just ran into the bank lobby to join in the excitement.

Yang Feifei stuck close to Tao Chenggang. When their turn came at the counter, she heard her boyfriend say, "Transfer fifty thousand to this card."

Fifty thousand?

Yang Feifei looked at her boyfriend, then turned to look at Chen Guiliang.

Why transfer fifty thousand to him? He doesn't look like he's in business.

Could he be a poor relative of the Tao family, here to borrow money?

Yang Feifei was unhappy. The total amount Tao Chenggang had spent on her was just a little over a thousand.

In a small city, it didn't take much money to pick up a vocational school girl.

Even a campus belle!

Tao Chenggang handed the bank card back to Chen Guiliang. "Little brother, you can go check at an ATM."

"No need."

Chen Guiliang glanced at the transfer slip.

Yang Yuhui muttered to himself, "Damn, he's really transferring the money."

Tao Chenggang checked his watch. "It's getting late. I'll take you guys to eat. We can talk while we eat."

The more Yang Feifei thought about it, the angrier she got. "Honey, didn't you promise to take me for Western food? Why are there two extra third wheels now?"

Tao Chenggang's brows furrowed. After a brief hesitation, he took out his wallet and said, "Take this thousand yuan and go. Consider it our breakup fee."

"You're breaking up with me for him?" Yang Feifei was incredulous.

"Get lost!"

Tao Chenggang shouted.

Yang Feifei snatched the one thousand yuan and said angrily, "Hmph, fine, let's break up."

She hadn't lost out. In just one month, she had gotten Tao Chenggang to spend over a thousand yuan on her, and even received a thousand yuan breakup fee.

Based on the local average salary, 2,000 yuan at this time had the purchasing power of over 10,000 yuan twenty years later!

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Just like that, you broke up?"

Tao Chenggang said, "When you're trying to do something big, it's best not to have women around. Besides, she was disrespectful to my friends, calling you two third wheels."

A ruthless man. I wish him success.

Yang Yuhui, on the other hand, was a little dejected. He said to Tao Chenggang, "Gang Ge, you promised your girlfriend would introduce me to a female student. Now that you've broken up, where am I supposed to find a girlfriend?"

"There'll be plenty of opportunities in the future. Once you have money, are you afraid you won't find a girlfriend?" Tao Chenggang comforted him.

Yang Yuhui pouted.

Tao Chenggang drove them to a small restaurant he had chosen and said to Chen Guiliang, "This place is pretty good. I used to come here a lot in high school. The name is just a bit unpleasant."

"Toilet Rabbit. I know, it's very famous."

Chen Guiliang wasn't lying.

This restaurant was indeed quite famous. More than a decade later, it would become an internet-famous spot, and its taste would become a bit less authentic.

Tao Chenggang said, "The main reason for this meal today is to have a chat with you, little brother."

Chen Guiliang said with a smile, "I'll tell you everything I know. Think of it as after-sales service."

With the deal closed, they were no longer secretly competing. Both felt they could deepen their friendship.

Having more friends is always a good thing.

Yang Yuhui had already pricked up his ears, wanting to know what exactly could be sold for 100,000.

Tao Chenggang ordered a case of beer and enthusiastically poured a glass for Chen Guiliang, then poured one for Yang Yuhui as well. "Little brother, you're young and promising. When I was your age, I didn't know anything except how to fight."

Chen Guiliang said, "I've heard about Boss Tao's glorious deeds from my uncle. In high school, you stood up for a friend and slashed someone with a knife."

"Gang Ge slashed someone in school to stand up for me. I'll never forget it for the rest of my life," Yang Yuhui said with an emotional tone.

Tao Chenggang waved his hands dismissively. "That was just some youthful foolishness. No need to bring it up now. This is a society ruled by law. We should all be law-abiding citizens."

A plate of cold appetizers was brought over. The three of them clinked glasses and drank casually.

After some small talk, Tao Chenggang's phone rang.

He said, "Excuse me," and answered the phone. "Yeah... yeah... yeah, I'm in a business meeting. Find a place to eat on your own."

After Tao Chenggang hung up, Chen Guiliang asked casually, "Boss Tao has other plans?"

Tao Chenggang explained, "My younger sister. She just finished browsing the Xinhua Bookstore. She's your schoolmate from No. 2 High, a freshman this year."

"What a coincidence," Chen Guiliang said, not realizing the situation.

Tao Chenggang poured Chen Guiliang more beer. "Little brother, you said what was written on the paper wasn't detailed enough. You have to explain it to me properly."

Chen Guiliang said, "The core concept of a free-to-play game is simply that regular players build the crowd, and paying players build the revenue. So you need to strike a balance, one that not only keeps the regular players around, but also makes the paying players willing to spend money. The two can also interact, making regular players feel like they're getting a good deal, while maxing out the emotional value for the paying players..."

"Wait a moment."

Tao Chenggang stood up and shouted, "Boss, can I borrow a pen and paper?"

To Yang Yuhui's astonishment, Tao Chenggang, like a diligent elementary school student, hunched over the dining table and took notes seriously.

"To maintain the online rate of regular players, you need to design a reasonable quest system. Especially daily fixed quests. After regular players finish their own, they can also help wealthy players with their quests, earning more in-game resources from them. As for the wealthy players, by spending money to have regular players at their beck and call, and being showered with compliments, they can also gain psychological satisfaction."

"You absolutely cannot sell equipment directly like on a private server. If you do that, regular players will be unhappy, and paying players won't get long-lasting satisfaction. If you're going to sell something, sell items, or materials for upgrading equipment."

"You can also have a check-in system. Checking in on a single day rewards money or items, while checking in for a certain number of consecutive days rewards rare items. This will increase player retention and online rates..."

At this point, Chen Guiliang thought for a moment and decided he might as well go all the way.

There was no point in holding back; this stuff would be obsolete soon anyway.

He could also use this to build up some goodwill, earning some favors for their future collaboration on a private server.

"Without spending a penny, there are ultimately no sunk costs. Regular players can quit whenever they want. You can set up VIP membership levels. Spending 10 yuan can make you a junior VIP. Display this VIP title for the player, as a kind of in-game title that can provide a small amount of title stats. Once they've paid once, they might pay countless times..."

"Players earn currency through daily check-ins or quests, which can potentially lead to inflation. You should set up two currency systems. One is for regular gold coins, which can only buy certain limited items. The other is for ingots, which are obtained through payment or special events, and can be used to buy everything except equipment..."

"Don't sell equipment directly, but you can sell equipment blueprints. With the blueprints, you still need various materials to craft the equipment. In the process of collecting materials, paying players will have more interaction with regular players..."

"You can also create chests of different levels, which drop during events or from killing monsters. Keys for wooden, black iron, and bronze chests can be obtained without paying. But for diamond, gold, and silver chests, you have to pay to get the keys. Opening the chests yields good items. This kind of gameplay creates more anticipation, just like buying a lottery ticket. Opening chests can get players completely hooked..."

"Then there are guilds and national wars..."

The more Tao Chenggang listened, the more excited he became. This was all fucking brilliant. He felt like he was about to become a billionaire.

Yang Yuhui, on the other hand, was dumbfounded. "Son of a bitch, he's got a whole system for swindling people."

Tao Chenggang asked, "Yuhui, what do you think of making a game like this?"

"It'll definitely be a hit," Yang Yuhui said decisively. "Those kids in my studio, when they first came, it wasn't for the salary. They mostly just wanted to play games for free. I know exactly what they're thinking. If we release a free-to-play game, it'll drive these young kids crazy."

Tao Chenggang burst out laughing.

After finishing his notes, Tao Chenggang carefully put them away, patted his chest, and raised his glass. "Little brother, I salute you. If this game fails halfway, then it's just my bad luck. But if by some chance it makes money, I will definitely thank you again generously! No matter how big my company gets, you're always welcome to visit. If you come for a tour, I'll personally accompany you the whole time. If you come for a position, I'll definitely give you a satisfactory one!"

Tao Chenggang was genuinely impressed, convinced that Chen Guiliang was a prodigy of his time.

Such a prodigy would surely accomplish great things in the future.

Even if they couldn't be business partners, he should still build a good relationship with him. Who knows when it might come in handy.

Tao Chenggang's thinking was very clear.

"You're too kind."

Chen Guiliang clinked his glass, a broader smile spreading across his face. "Boss Tao, let's talk about another business deal."

This was Chen Guiliang's true purpose.

He wasn't satisfied with just 50,000 yuan.

"Another deal?" Tao Chenggang looked stunned.

Chen Guiliang said, "Game development is incredibly expensive. I want to help Boss Tao make his starting capital more abundant."

Tao Chenggang said nothing, just stared at Chen Guiliang.

This high school student, the moment they met, said he would give him a fortune, but ended up making him pay for a few sheets of paper.

Now he was saying he would help make his starting capital more abundant, which probably meant he wanted him to fork over another sum of money!

He had been led by the nose from the very beginning.

Where did this little demon come from?

Since Hong Kong, it's been known that Lao Wang has a harem, why are so many single female lead characters suddenly popping up?
